WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
timing_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing') as timing,
    AVG(instownpct) as timing_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
above_avg_timings AS (
  SELECT 
    t.timing_avg,
    t.timing_avg - o.overall_avg as above_by
  FROM timing_avgs t
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE t.timing_avg > o.overall_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(timing_avg) as mean_of_above_avg_timings,
  AVG(above_by) as how_far_above_average_on_average
FROM above_avg_timings
